Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: it was really difficult and stressfull due to lack of information. There are several campuses and therefore the timeslot of the courses have to be perfect for you to apply for the courses otherwise you cannot make it from one end of prague to the other.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The international office
